# Pruning My Pothos

> A publication and working lab about understanding AI by building with it,
> inspecting it, and explaining what holds up. Written by Shailesh Rawat.
> Systems explains how applied AI systems work. Storyboard Explainers makes
> the ideas easier to see. Current Work shows them being tested in real
> tools. Shelf traces the references and experiments behind all of it.

Author: Shailesh Rawat, AI Systems Consultant and Technical Communicator.
Site: https://pruningmypothos.com/

## Sections

- [Systems](https://pruningmypothos.com/systems/): long-form explainers and breakdowns of AI systems
- [Storyboard Explainers](https://pruningmypothos.com/storyboards/): a visual index into the diagrams inside the Systems explainers, not a separate body of content
- [Current Work](https://pruningmypothos.com/current-work/): applied AI systems and tools being built and tested, with repository excerpts where evidence is shown
- [Shelf](https://pruningmypothos.com/shelf/): experiments, resources, notes and references

## Also published

- [Sentences](https://pruningmypothos.com/sentences/): short decision rules and observations
- [Self](https://pruningmypothos.com/self/): essays on practice, judgment and learning in public
- [Tools](https://pruningmypothos.com/tools/): browser-native, local-first utilities that send nothing to a server
- [Docs](https://pruningmypothos.com/docs/): reference documentation for the working model
- [Schema](https://pruningmypothos.com/schema/): the thinking underneath the work
- [About](https://pruningmypothos.com/about/): who builds this and why
